scope: PDF 2.0 / EC3 §8.7.4.1, .2, .4, .5.1, .5.2; bounded to common shading rules as they affect Type 1, and Type 1 function-based shading semantics. Types 2–7 are not re-audited.

source_basis.annotations: Physical pages 243–248 have only internal Link annotations; no editorial annotation changes the selected provisions.
source_basis.errata: doc/errata-read.md has no applicable correction to these provisions.

features.feature: shading paints a colour field independent of the current fill colour; Type 2 pattern and Shading entries are distinct
features.source_location: Printed p.228 / physical PDF p.243; Table 75 printed p.229 / physical p.244
features.ledger: implemented; Table 75 row and shading resource/application rows
features.assertion_review: Existing display-list/raster shading tests exercise actual paint. No Type 1-specific gap found in this general rule.

features.feature: sh applies the shading over the current clipping path in current user space; current colour is unaffected; Background is ignored for sh
features.assertion_review: shadings.rs includes direct-sh coverage for clipping and Background ignored, but direct Background test is axial. Type 1 absent-Background domain coverage exists; combining Type 1 plus Background and sh would improve branch-specific regression strength (draft).

features.feature: colour-space-specific evaluation/interpolation rules, including no Indexed colour space for a shading whose colour is generated by a Function
features.assertion_review: The Indexed restriction is a producer constraint and does not establish that a reader must reject a nonconforming Indexed Type 1 shading. No reader defect inferred from acceptance. Interpolation-specific cross-space behavior is outside this bounded Type 1 geometry audit.

features.feature: common shading dictionary entries apply with Table 77 semantics
features.source_location: Printed p.232 / physical PDF p.247; Table 77 printed pp.230–231 / physical pp.245–246
features.assertion_review: Background and BBox have meaningful raster assertions, although the common BBox test is Type 2. AntiAlias is described as an optional flag indicating whether to filter, defaults false, and has an explanatory NOTE about sampling and cost. I found no separate source sentence authorizing readers to ignore a true value; exact filter behavior remains an implementation-dependent/interpretation coverage question, not a proven defect from this pass.

features.feature: Type 1 Domain rectangle, Matrix mapping to target space, Function arity/domain/output range, and outside-transformed-domain behavior
features.source_location: Printed p.233 / physical PDF p.248; Table 78 same page
features.assertion_review: Current tests have independent matrix-color and rotated-domain controls, device-pixel discontinuity and grid partition controls, and a pattern Background/no-Background comparison. No test found that combines a nonidentity Type 1 Matrix with the common BBox in target coordinates; proposed draft covers this seam. Existing tests specify Domain and Matrix explicitly; defaults are supported in code but omission-vs-explicit-default assertion was not found.

implementation_review.type1_parse: crates/pdf-colour/src/shading.rs::function_based reads four Domain numbers or defaults to [0,1,0,1], parses the function group, and builds a deferred colour source. Cache::build supplies Matrix identity when omitted.
implementation_review.type1_sampling: crates/pdf-render/src/shading.rs::Shading::sampled_at maps the unit grid over the Type 1 Domain, then applies shading and caller transforms.
implementation_review.clip_and_background: crates/pdf-model/src/content/pattern/shading.rs::paint_clip installs the common BBox clip and, for Type 1 without Background, a domain parallelogram clip. With Background it leaves domain exterior to the rasterizer; direct sh follows its separate route and ignores Background.
implementation_review.bbox: Common BBox is carried in target placement coordinates and combined with current clip; existing asserted public raster fixture currently demonstrates Type 2 only.

verdict: source-and-code-supported-partial; no confirmed Type 1 normative defect found in inspected features; Type1 Matrix × BBox public regression gap drafted, not executed
residuals: No execution performed in this shard; parent owns serialized Rust validation.
No exhaustive validation of Type 1 function families or all colour spaces.
No fixed pixel oracle proposed for AntiAlias because exact filtering is device sampling-dependent; no separate permission to ignore true was established.
The function-domain superset requirement constrains conforming producers; no unsupported reader-rejection obligation inferred.
